description: Agent Market Radar — A market pulse with receipts. Combine a timestamped Finnhub equity quote, price-change metrics and relevant global news into a single machine-readable signal board. Spot movement and event context without pretending an unverified headline caused the price. Customer supplies market data key. One call costs 0.01 USDC on Base x402; customer-owned provider credentials use X-Provider-Key header where needed.

news_query.description: Optional exact news topic; defaults to stock ticker

symbol.description: Finnhub-supported stock ticker, e.g. AAPL; key in X-Provider-Key

name: api_agent_market_radar
